titulo: A FOTO QUE PARECIA OUTRA VIDA
personagens: Sofia, a woman around 28 with long straight black hair and bangs, denim jacket and yellow scarf; her mother, a woman in her late 50s with short gray hair and glasses; an elderly kind neighbor lady around 75 with white hair in a bun and a floral apron
cenario: a family home attic and an old neighborhood street with a bakery, a red bicycle and a house with a blue window
cenas: Sofia kneeling in a dusty attic opening an old cardboard box, pulling out a faded photograph, astonished
Sofia holding the photograph up to the attic window light, recognizing something from her dreams
Close-up of the torn photograph showing a small bakery, a red bicycle and a blue window, next to Sofia's open sketchbook with the same drawing
Sofia turning the photo over to see faded handwriting on the back, her mother hesitating in the doorway
Sofia and her mother sitting at the kitchen table, the photo between them, a tense and careful conversation
Memory scene of a younger Sofia as a small girl being cared for at night by the kind elderly neighbor in a warm living room
Sofia looking through old family albums on the floor, piecing the story together
Sofia walking down a real street that matches the photo, bakery, red bicycle and blue window, in golden afternoon light
Sofia meeting the elderly neighbor at the renovated bakery, the old lady handing her a tin box full of childhood drawings
Sofia sitting on the bakery bench holding the photo and the tin box, smiling with tears, feeling at home
